chunks: Muḥammad ibn Sahl narrated from al-Riḍā عليه السلام that he said:
"The Imam bears the mistakes or forgetfulness of those behind him, except the opening takbir."

key_terms.أَوْهَامَ: mistakes, misapprehensions, or forgetfulness in prayer
key_terms.الْإِمَامُ: the prayer leader in congregational salat (prayer)
key_terms.تَكْبِيرَةَ الِافْتِتَاحِ: the opening takbir that begins the prayer

ai.seo_question: What mistakes of a follower in congregational prayer are borne by the Imam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling related to congregational salat (prayer), indicating that the Imam covers certain mistakes or forgetfulness of the followers in prayer. It makes an exception for the opening takbir, showing its particular importance and the personal responsibility of each worshipper for it.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1206 - Muhammad ibn Sahl narrated from Imam Al-Ridha (as) that He said:
"The Imam bears the mistakes (or forgetfulness) of those who pray behind him, except for the opening takbir (takbirat al-ihram)."
